role.title: Role of this machine
role.description: Lucania links two machines: the server runs the models, the receiver uses them.
role.label: Role of this machine

tower.title: This machine is used as a server
tower.text: It runs the models and makes them available to another machine.

laptop.title: This machine is used as a receiver
laptop.text: The chat stays here, the models run on the server machine.

tower.title: Set up the server
tower.description: Turn on server mode, then copy the code to paste on the other machine.
tower.note: Once server mode is on, the screen is reserved for the server until it is stopped.

laptop.title: Connect to the server
laptop.description: Paste the code shown on the server machine, pick the network, then connect.

shutdown.title: Remote shutdown (optional)
shutdown.description: Add the machines you want to be able to shut down from Lucania. You can also do this later.

recap.title: Summary
recap.description: Here is the state of the connection between your machines.

client.label: Server in use
client.none: No server: this machine uses its own engine
